abstract: Fetus in fetu (FIF) is a rare congenital anomaly in which a dysmorphic, parasitic twin is retained within the body of its host twin. It typically presents in infancy, shows a slight male predominance, and is most often located in the retroperitoneum. Differentiating FIF from an abdominal teratoma on imaging is important, as the two entities can closely resemble one another. We report the case of a 10-year-old boy who presented with abdominal pain, low-grade fever, and unintentional weight loss. Antenatal history was unremarkable. Abdominal examination revealed mild distension and left-sided tenderness. Ultrasonography demonstrated an 8.5 × 10.4 × 11.1 cm mass-like lesion in the left hypochondrium, and a provisional diagnosis of teratoma versus FIF was considered. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) of the abdomen showed a large, well-defined, heterogeneous mesenteric mass measuring 10.0 × 11.0 × 14.0 cm containing macroscopic fat, dense tooth-like calcifications, and osseous elements with attenuation of up to 1450 Hounsfield units, together with a well-formed fetal skeleton. Serum tumor markers were within normal limits. A presumptive diagnosis of FIF, supported by imaging and by intraoperative findings that satisfied the Willis criteria, was made at exploratory laparotomy; histopathological confirmation could not be obtained because the specimen was inadequately fixed prior to processing, so a highly differentiated fetiform teratoma cannot be entirely excluded. The child remained well at last follow-up, about 10 weeks after discharge; longer surveillance is required. This case illustrates that FIF, although classically a diagnosis of infancy, should remain in the differential diagnosis of a complex abdominal mass in an older child, and highlights the role of the Willis criteria, radiological correlation, and intraoperative findings when histopathology is unavailable.
abstract_ja: 胎児内胎児(FIF)は、双生児の一方が宿主の体内に寄生し、ねじれた形で残存する稀な先天異常である。通常は乳児期に発症し、男児にやや多く、最も多い部位は後腹膜である。画像検査ではFIFと腹部奇形腫が類似することがあるため、両者の鑑別は重要である。10歳男児が腹痛、微熱、体重減少で受診した。出生前歴に特記事項はなかった。腹部診察では軽度の膨満と左側の圧痛を認めた。超音波検査では左季肋部に8.5×10.4×11.1 cmの腫瘤様病変を認め、奇形腫とFIFの鑑別が考えられた。造影CTでは10.0×11.0×14.0 cmの境界明瞭で不均一な腸間膜腫瘤を認め、脂肪成分、歯牙様の石灰化、CT値最大1450 HUの骨成分を含み、整った胎児骨格を伴っていた。血清腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲内であった。開腹探索術での術中所見がWillis基準を満たしたため、FIFと暫定診断した。しかし検体の固定が不十分で病理組織学的確認は得られず、高分化型胎児様奇形腫は完全には除外できない。退院後約10週間の時点で患児は良好で、より長期の経過観察が必要である。本症例は、古典的には乳児期の診断であるFIFも、年長児の複雑な腹部腫瘤の鑑別に留めるべきであり、病理組織が得られない場合にはWillis基準、画像所見との整合性、術中所見が重要であることを示す。
